text:
Items before: fruit bowl (watermelon, strawberries, grapes, blueberries, melon), roughly 150 g, about 50 kcal. Two rice-paper rolls, probably with chicken or pork and lettuce, about 100 g each, so around 200 g and 250 kcal. A cola drink of about 250 ml is roughly 100 kcal, and a small cup of sauce, about 15 g, adds 15 kcal. Water has no calories.

After: the fruit is all eaten, leaving only some juice. The rolls are eaten, with some sauce residue on the plate. The sauce cup still looks mostly full and was not eaten. The cola cup is empty, so the cola was drunk.

Whether to count the cola as food is a judgment call. I'll include it, since it carries energy.

Fruit: 150 g, 50 kcal. Rolls: 200 g, 230 kcal. Cola: 250 g, 105 kcal. Some sauce was used, since the plate shows brown residue. I'll count about 8 g and 10 kcal.

Total is about 395 kcal and about 600 g.
